info.name: Uponly Products - TrialX
info.description:
# Uponly Additional Products - TrialX build

Orchestration APIs for the additional Uponly products, built and tested in the TrialX tenant (MC). Same request shape as the Uponly PA001 collection: `ProductCode` + `ProductSubcode`, native policy JSON (`PolicyLobList / PolicyRiskList / BeneficiaryList / PolicyPaymentInfoList`).

**Variables**: `baseUrl` (TrialX MC test route), `token` (Bearer token of the machine/API user), and `proposalNo`, `policyNo`, `rejectProposalNo` which the tests fill in as you run a variant folder top to bottom.

**Products**: UPPA001 (PA reference: sub 1 with TTD, sub 2 without), TL001 (sub 1 with Travel, 2 without), FP001, HC001, CI001 (sub 1/2/3 = 7/11/32 CI), LP001 (annual/monthly), DH001.

**Behaviour to know**
- Premium comes from ProductPlanRelation via the product premium calculation. BeforeVatPremium and the risk-level DuePremium equal the plan premium in the spec sheet; the policy-level DuePremium also includes the TrialX tenant GST rate (4%).
- Commission is stored but never returned by these APIs.
- Premium modes: 1 Single, 2 Annual, 3 Monthly (Life Protect only). Single-premium term 2-10 years, otherwise 1 year. Entry age 18-64, maximum age 69, maximum age at exit 70.
- Payment details can be sent with the proposal or at enrolment (update-proposal) and are returned as PolicyPaymentInfoList.
- Errors: HTTP 400 `{status, code UP-400, message, api, trace_id}`, 404 for not found.

request.description: Plans, premiums and benefits for this variant. Commission is never returned. Age and premium-mode/term rules from ProductRule are checked when the insured date of birth is supplied.
